issue: Does 18 U.S.C. § 1114 apply to the murder or attempted murder of a U.S. officer committed outside U.S. territory?

sides.position: Section 1114 does not apply outside U.S. sovereign territory.
cases: United States v. Garcia Sota, 948 F.3d 356 (D.C. Cir. 2020)
United States v. Flores, 995 F.3d 214 (D.C. Cir. 2021)

sides.position: Section 1114 applies beyond the sovereign territory of the United States.
cases: United States v. Al Kassar, 660 F.3d 108 (2d Cir. 2011)
United States v. Benitez, 741 F.2d 1312 (11th Cir. 1984)
United States v. Flores, 995 F.3d 214 (D.C. Cir. 2021)

this_court: Holds that § 1114 does not apply outside U.S. territory, following Garcia Sota. The majority applied that rule to vacate the § 1114 convictions; the dissent disputes that result and argues the issue was not preserved and was invited error.
quote: Two circuits disagree with this court’s decision in Garcia Sota and hold that § 1114 applies beyond the sovereign territory of the United States.
cite: United States v. Francisco Flores, 995 F.3d 214 (D.C. Cir. 2021)
